notes: The Item folder named Do these is now the authoritative finished firearm set.
Every weapon inside the seven manufacturer subfolders is accepted by folder membership, including repaired or variant-looking names such as Neon entries.
The finalizer preserves manual Foundry mechanics, description-card edits, and GM notes; it only applies manufacturer/readiness/Market flags.
Previously managed guns outside Do these are demoted so they do not duplicate the finalized set in the Market.
The weapon catalog skips Do these world items and finalized copies so loader migrations cannot overwrite reviewed gun stats.
Weapon Readiness now uses the live Do these folder count instead of assuming exactly 81 finished guns.
